gaps.title: Confirm the site boundary and proposed works
gaps.reason: The search uses a supplied point and approximate enclosing box; it does not establish a site boundary or construction loads.
actions: Confirm the boundary, levels, proposed structures, loading and access constraints.
Agree the desk-study and investigation objectives with the project geotechnical engineer.

gaps.title: Review the original investigation records
gaps.reason: 6 unique index candidates were retrieved. Index entries do not establish usable stratigraphy or test parameters; search gaps remain possible.
actions: Open the original logs or AGS files under their applicable terms.
Review location precision, age, investigation purpose, depths, sampling and relevance to the proposed works.
Record relevance and reasons for each candidate before planning additional investigation.

gaps.title: Establish a site-specific conceptual ground model
gaps.reason: Implemented geology is 1:625,000 regional mapping. It cannot resolve local strata, fill, weathering or founding levels.
actions: Obtain suitably detailed mapping and relevant historic records.
Review a site walkover and original investigation logs; identify unresolved strata and geological boundaries.

gaps.title: Establish site groundwater conditions
gaps.reason: Nearby stations and latest available readings do not establish the site's aquifer, seasonal groundwater range or pore pressures.
actions: Review station/aquifer relevance, observation dates, units, datum and per-reading quality.
Obtain relevant historical series and agree site monitoring where required.
Keep groundwater elevation and depth below ground distinct.

gaps.title: Obtain evidence for geotechnical design parameters
gaps.reason: Strength, stiffness, permeability, bearing pressure and design groundwater level remain unestablished.
actions: Define required parameters from the proposed works and conceptual ground model.
Agree appropriate field and laboratory investigation, quality requirements and interpretation with the geotechnical engineer.

gaps.title: Review site history and potential contamination
gaps.reason: This workflow does not retrieve a complete historic land-use record, remediation history or site contamination assessment.
actions: Review historic maps, former uses, local records and relevant environmental reports.
Define contamination questions and investigation needs from evidenced source-pathway-receptor relationships.

gaps.title: Obtain relevant mining and ground-hazard evidence
gaps.reason: The implemented sources do not provide a comprehensive mine-workings, dissolution or ground-stability search.
actions: Establish whether mining or other ground-hazard searches are relevant from detailed geology and site history.
Obtain authorised records and investigate unresolved features where relevant.

gaps.title: Confirm utilities and safe investigation access
gaps.reason: Public evidence does not establish buried utility positions, depths, absence or investigation clearance.
actions: Obtain current asset-owner records and appropriate utility surveys.
Confirm permissions, access, service avoidance and investigation constraints before intrusive work.

gaps.title: Review terrain, drainage and neighbouring assets
gaps.reason: The workflow does not ingest terrain surveys, drainage condition, structure condition or a site walkover.
actions: Review site levels, slopes, drainage, adjacent structures and signs of previous movement during a walkover.
Obtain surveyed levels and asset information appropriate to the proposed works.

gaps.title: Review incomplete query query-004
actions: Review pagination and provider metadata before treating the retrieved page as a complete search.
If relevant, continue within an agreed request budget and retain the search history.
